final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out * out <= n and (out + 1) * (out + 1) > n
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(16) == 4
  if n < 2
    return n
  var low = 1
  var high = n // 2
  if high > 3037000499
    high = 3037000499
  var ans = 1
  while low <= high
    let mid = low + (high - low) // 2
    if mid <= n // mid
      ans = mid
      low = mid + 1
    else
      high = mid - 1
  ans

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(0) == 0
  assert isqrt(1) == 1
  assert isqrt(2) == 1
  assert isqrt(3) == 1
  assert isqrt(4) == 2
  assert isqrt(8) == 2
  assert isqrt(9) == 3
  assert isqrt(15) == 3
  assert isqrt(16) == 4
  assert isqrt(17) == 4
